title: Run it every morning
intro: You want a PR review every weekday at 9am. Pick how.

show.title: Cloud scheduled task
show.detail: It runs as a cloud session on schedule, even with your laptop off.

show.title: Only while open
show.detail: A loop runs inside your session, so it stops when Claude Code closes.

show.title: Too frequent
show.detail: Custom schedules can't run more than once an hour.

fallback.title: Pick an option
fallback.detail: Choose one of the options to see what happens.

quiz.question: What else can start a cloud scheduled task, besides a schedule?
options: An API call or a GitHub event
quiz.explanation: Tasks can fire on a schedule, from an API call, or on GitHub events.
